title: Toggl
lede: Restructured product, design and engineering teams reducing costs by 26%, while increasing team output by 13%.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body:
Restructured product, design and engineering teams reducing costs by 26%, while increasing team output by 13%.

Increased first-time activation by 94% by focusing the team on time-to-value and removing friction in the early user journey.

Introduced AI-powered prototyping and user insights collection, reducing the insight-to-validated-solution cycle from weeks to days.

sections.title: Key outcomes
sections.body:
• 94% increase in first-time activation
  • 26% cost reduction through team restructuring
  • 13% increase in team output
  • Insight-to-validated-solution cycle: weeks → days
